epic:#33595#1 · os-tesla · session_01L9qiby1cctpVpRbJzjccvY

To: next eval seat (#33468 vacant since 2026-11-16 07:17Z)
Notify: landed (mailbox #33469 is closed, so this is posted on the seat post) · #33595 M3 · 2026-11-16T09:05Z

All four M3 children are merged. The table, with PRs and merge commits, is on #33595 (M3 summary 6912055917). The last to land was #34294 (`f59a4aa0`), which restores the seeded rows before each operation.

Three of the changes move scores:
- #34293: a `pending_confirmation` operation now has to make the confirmed write too.
- #34294: an operation no longer inherits an earlier turn's write.
- #34296: the control cards now ask 14 / 14 / 13 questions, and Chinese asks are on.

Compare runs only on or after `f59a4aa0`.

New tool: `objectstack-scenarios summary <dir>` (#34295) builds the author × ask table from your run records.

Owed to you: any M3 close-out run, plus the M2 recommendation card (cloud haiku + effort medium) if eval#1 did not file it. The epic seat has clocked out, and the epic has no PM seat now.

eval#1 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpxQpmErd1ixfkgbYh

**Seated · round opened** 2026-11-17T09:27Z.

- **Mutex:** the clock-out brief in this post's body (2026-11-16) was followed only by the epic seat's `Notify: landed` 6912067979, read here. So the seat was taken at once.
- **Summons, verbatim, in this session:** 「按照最新的裁决 34632，你同时负责 qa eval」. This seat is held with `qa#1` (#31433) as the verification seat (#34632 D6-A).
- **Rule text read at:** `lanes/eval.md` and `scenario-eval/SKILL.md` touch `c3c0c30d6`; `pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` touch `8dd8192cb` (first read in this session).
- **Patrol:** `trig_016zQTotaCLstXdxgNsg7NW2` replaces the disabled `trig_01EMWRjYEwP1Te8nCkHrPsZy`.
- **This round:** the M3 close-out scenario-card run that 6912067979 says is owed. Subject on or after `f59a4aa0`; it compares against #34320 by percentage only.
- **D3 (daily 问数 baseline):** not run. No fixed hosted test environment with persona credentials is on record. The seat reports the blocker to the maintainer and spends no API budget until that environment exists.

eval#1 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpxQpmErd1ixfkgbYh

**Direction changed by the maintainer** 2026-11-17T14:19Z. In this seat's session, verbatim: 「你这个应该调整方向，暂时主要是考虑优化 mcp 问数功能」.

What changes, until the maintainer says otherwise:
- **Primary focus: MCP 问数.** That is the scenario cards' ask mode: Claude Code answering questions and running operations through the MCP door, scored deterministically, on the subscription with no API key.
  - The seat measures it and attributes every lost question to one owner: P (the MCP door or platform), A (the agent) or R (card or scorer).
  - Each P-class loss goes out through the filing gate, toward the MCP phase-2 epic #34659 and its open children.
  - Each fix that lands is re-measured.
- **Set aside for now:** the product-internal 问数 baseline (#34632 D3, `run-ask-accuracy-cli.ts`). It needed a fixed hosted test environment that does not exist, so its daily blocker note stops here. The ruling text itself is unchanged; this is the maintainer's priority on top of it.
- **Unchanged:** the weekly scenario-card round and the QA rounds (#34632 D2).
- **Charter fit:** the seat still writes no code and dispatches no dev. "Optimising" here means measuring, attributing and filing, then re-testing.

eval#1 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpxQpmErd1ixfkgbYh

**Scope widened by the maintainer** 2026-11-17T14:22Z. Asked in this seat's session whether the six `starter` cards join the fixed MCP 问数 measurement beside the three `control` cards, at several times the subscription quota per round, the maintainer answered verbatim: 「同意加」.

- The MCP 问数 measurement now covers all nine cards, control and starter, in ask mode.
- Each card is measured on a fixed template build (`--modes ask --template F`) with `--ask-repeats 3`, so a score moves only with the MCP door and the agent.
- The re-measure trigger is unchanged: a child of #34659 closes, or a PR touching the MCP door merges.

eval#1 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpxQpmErd1ixfkgbYh

**Correction** 2026-11-17T15:06Z: the MCP 问数 measurement follows #34869. The maintainer, verbatim, in this seat's session: 「以 #34869 为准」.

This supersedes the plan in the two comments above (nine scenario cards, scratch-built then asked, `--ask-repeats 3`, re-measured when a child of #34659 lands). That plan authored a build per card, at about $20–27 of authoring per starter card, so it measured authoring as much as the MCP door.

What stands now:
- **The MCP ask round is the one #34869 describes:**
  - the open runner's ask mode, locally booted, on a subscription login, with no cloud access;
  - over the cards that carry datasets (#34687);
  - one repetition daily and five weekly, model and effort pinned, each round an `eval-run` record.
- **#34869 is `pm:blocked` on #34687**, and its charter text is not merged. This seat runs no MCP ask round until #34687 closes. The charter text is the devx lane's to write, not this seat's.
- **The two baseline runners dispatched at 14:41Z** were stopped and archived at 15:05Z before reporting:
  - `session_01QSeKYotartBijyPiUi4PTo`
  - `session_01QSeKYmgdxxpiYb7q57dhP5`

  Nothing from them is recorded.
- **Unchanged:** the weekly scenario-card round and the QA rounds (#34632 D2). The product-internal baseline (#34632 D3) stays set aside.

repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CaAqjP52wVTzs99H5G

**Moved here from the skill** · 2026-11-19T09:21Z

The maintainer ruled that current values leave the pm-dispatch skill and live on the seat post (ruling record on #35215, comment 7001649654; landed by PR #35406). These lines left `references/lanes/eval.md` and now live here, verbatim:

- Cadence: 「场景卡与 ⑥ 每周一轮,问数基线与 ⑤ 每天」 (the rule 「定时归本席自控(维护者令)」 stays in the skill).
- Suite size: 「题集 56 题、每题 5 次」.
- Spend gate: 「首周实际花费报维护者后才加量」.
- When the two pending items join the routine: ③ 托管聊天评测集的 13 个场景 — 「仓库密钥配齐后纳入」; ④ AI 写数据五道关卡 — 「建成后纳入例行」.

The skill now points here for these values. Change them here, not in the skill.
